summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (package.json: "preinstall": "node setup.mjs") runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts and chmods it executable, and then invokes it via execFileSync on the bundled file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~728 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled JavaScript payload (banner `// @bun @bun-cjs`, obfuscator.io-style random-identifier variables, a large hex/int string-array and a rotating shuffle function), shipped without source, build script, or any relation to the advertised rollup-postcss functionality. Package name @ornikar/rollup-plugin-postcss mirrors the well-known unscoped rollup-plugin-postcss and copies its author metadata (EGOIST <0x142857@gmail.com>), repository, and homepage; the legitimate package ships no preinstall, no setup.mjs, and no math_init.js. The result is that `npm install` of this package fetches an alien runtime and uses it to execute an opaque, unrelated payload on the installer's host — the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern combined with scope hijack of a well-known package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
